fusions.name: Dart-Tip Quiver
fusions.desc: Fires a poisoned arrow that deals 6 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sprung Release
fusions.desc: Looses a spring-tight arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sudden Backhop
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 8 seconds and puts you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Startled Leap
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
